```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 确认person文件存在
stopifnot(file.exists("../data/raw/perv2pub.csv"))

# 读取个人数据

  "../data/raw/perv2pub.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 查看数据规模
dim(person)
```




```{r}
person_check <- required_person %in% names(person)

cat("===== 个人数据变量检查 =====\n")


# 检查核心变量是否存在
required_person <- c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "R_AGE", "HTPPOPDN", "CNTTDTR", "WORKER", "HHSIZE", "HHVEHCNT", "TRAVDAY", "TDAYDATE", "WTPERFIN")

print(data.frame(

```


```{r}
# 2. 检查行程数据 trip
trip_check <- required_trip %in% names(trip)

required_trip <- c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "TRIPID", "TRPMILES")

cat("\n===== 行程数据变量检查 =====\n")

```


```{r}
stopifnot(
  all(required_person %in% names(person)),

)
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 7: 检查行程距离
# ==================================================

trip <- trip %>% mutate( miles = parse_double(TRPMILES))

# 数据整体摘要
summary(trip$miles)
```


```{r}
# 检查原始编码
trip %>% count(TRPMILES, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# 专门统计异常编码
trip %>%
  summarise(
    total_trips = n(),
    missing_value = sum(is.na(miles)),
    negative_distance = sum(
      miles < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    zero_distance = sum(
      miles == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    valid_distance = sum(
      is.finite(miles) & miles >= 0
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# 检查负数的具体编码
trip %>%
  filter(miles < 0) %>%
  count(TRPMILES)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 8: 核验数据主键
# ==================================================

# 个人表：一人一行
anyDuplicated(person[c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID")])

# 行程表：一人可能有多次行程
# 但每次行程的联合键应唯一
anyDuplicated(trip[c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "TRIPID")])

# 检查是否有找不到所属个人的行程
unmatched_trips <- trip %>% anti_join( person, by = c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID"))

nrow(unmatched_trips)

# 统计每个人有多少条行程
trip_counts <- trip %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trips = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
# 查看结果
head(trip_counts)
```


```{r}
# 有行程记录的独立受访者人数
nrow(trip_counts)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 9: 构建个人平均行程距离
# ==================================================

trip_summary <- trip %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
  summarise(
    # 这个人有多少次行程
    n_trips = n(),

    # 判断全部已记录行程距离是否有效
    all_distances_valid = all(
      is.finite(miles) & miles >= 0
    ),

    # 如果全部有效，才计算平均值
    mean_trip_miles = if (all_distances_valid) {
      mean(miles)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 查看新生成的汇总表
glimpse(trip_summary)
```


```{r}
# 检查结果
trip_summary %>%
  summarise(
    n_persons = n(),
    invalid_persons = sum(!all_distances_valid),
    valid_persons = sum(all_distances_valid),
    zero_mean = sum(
      mean_trip_miles == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 10: 合并个人与行程汇总数据
# ==================================================

person_day <- person %>%
  left_join(
    trip_summary,
    by = c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

# 确认连接后没有新增或丢失个人
nrow(person_day)
nrow(person)

stopifnot(
  nrow(person_day) == nrow(person)
)
```


```{r}
# 查看部分记录
person_day %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID, PERSONID,
    R_AGE, HTPPOPDN,
    n_trips, mean_trip_miles
  ) %>%
  head(10)
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 11: 检查行程数量一致性
# ==================================================

person_day <- person_day %>%
  mutate(
    reported_trips = parse_integer(CNTTDTR),

    recorded_trips = coalesce(
      n_trips, 0L
    )
  )

# 不一致的受访者
mismatch <- person_day %>%
  filter(
    is.na(reported_trips) |
    recorded_trips != reported_trips
  )

# 查看不一致人数
nrow(mismatch)
```


```{r}
# 检查无行程人数
person_day %>%
  summarise(
    all_persons = n(),
    with_trips = sum(recorded_trips > 0),
    without_trips = sum(recorded_trips == 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 12: 筛选成年人
# ==================================================

person_day <- person_day %>%
  mutate(
    age = parse_double(R_AGE)
  )

# 检查年龄分布
summary(person_day$age)
```


```{r}
# 检查年龄缺失
sum(is.na(person_day$age))

# 筛选18岁及以上
adult <- person_day %>%
  filter(age >= 18)

# 查看剩余人数
nrow(adult)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 13: 筛选有行程的成年人
# ==================================================

# 先检查有行程和无行程的人数
adult %>%
  count(
    has_trip = recorded_trips > 0
  )

# 只保留有行程记录的人
traveller <- adult %>%
  filter(recorded_trips > 0)
```


```{r}
nrow(traveller)
```

### 执行代码

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 14: 排除距离无效的个人
# ==================================================

# 先查看有多少人存在无效距离
traveller %>%
  count(all_distances_valid)
```


```{r}
# 保留全部行程距离有效的人
complete_distance <- traveller %>%
  filter(all_distances_valid)

nrow(complete_distance)

# 再次检查平均距离是否有效
sum(
  is.na(complete_distance$mean_trip_miles)
)
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 15: 筛选有效人口密度
# ==================================================

# 查看原始人口密度代码分布
complete_distance %>%
  count(HTPPOPDN, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# 构建八个有效类别代码
valid_density_codes <- sprintf(
  "%02d", 1:8
)

valid_density_codes

# 筛选有效人口密度
known_density <- complete_distance %>%
  filter(
    HTPPOPDN %in% valid_density_codes
  )

nrow(known_density)
```

```{r}
sprintf("%02d", 1:8)
```

```{r}

    hh_size = parse_double(HHSIZE),
    vehicles = parse_double(HHVEHCNT),
    person_weight = parse_double(WTPERFIN)

# 工作状态分布
known_density %>%
  count(WORKER)
```


```{r}

summary(known_density$hh_size)
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
# 调查日星期

```


```{r}
# 个人调查权重
summary(known_density$person_weight)
```


```{r}
# 地区控制变量检查
known_density %>%

```


```{r}
# 调查年月检查
known_density %>%
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- known_density %>%
  filter(
    WORKER %in% c("01", "02"),
    hh_size > 0,
    vehicles >= 0,
    TRAVDAY %in% sprintf("%02d", 1:7),
    is.finite(person_weight),
    person_weight > 0
  )

nrow(analysis_data)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# Step 17: 变量重编码
# ==================================================

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(

    # 1. 核心自变量：Tract人口密度
    density_band = factor(
      HTPPOPDN,
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:8)
    ),

    # 2. 工作状态
    worker = factor(
      WORKER,
      levels = c("01", "02"),
      labels = c("worker", "not_worker")
    ),

    # 3. 家庭车辆分组
    car_group = factor(
      case_when(
        vehicles == 0 ~ "0",
        vehicles == 1 ~ "1",
        vehicles >= 2 ~ "2+"
      ),
      levels = c("0", "1", "2+")
    ),

    # 4. 调查日星期
    day_of_week = factor(
      TRAVDAY,
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:7),
      labels = c(
        "Sunday",
        "Monday",
        "Tuesday",
        "Wednesday",
        "Thursday",
        "Friday",
        "Saturday"
      )
    ),

    # 5. 调查时期
    survey_period = factor(TDAYDATE),

    # 6. 区域类别
    census_region = factor(CENSUS_R),

    # 7. 转换为公里
    mean_trip_km = mean_trip_miles * 1.609344,

    # 8. 预先构建对数变换版本
    log_mean_trip = log1p(mean_trip_miles)
  )

head(select(analysis_data,
    density_band,
    worker,
    car_group,
    day_of_week,
    survey_period,
    census_region,
    mean_trip_km,
    log_mean_trip))
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# 最终核查 A：样本数量
# ==================================================

# 有效成年出行者
nrow(analysis_data)

# 不同家庭数
n_distinct(analysis_data$HOUSEID)

# 不同个人数
n_distinct(
  analysis_data$HOUSEID,
  analysis_data$PERSONID
)

# 同一人是否存在重复记录
anyDuplicated(
  analysis_data[c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID")]
)
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# 最终核查 B：因变量
# ==================================================

summary(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles)

sum(is.na(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles))

sum(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles < 0)

sum(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles == 0)

quantile(
  analysis_data$mean_trip_miles,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# 最终核查 C：人口密度
# ==================================================

analysis_data %>%
  group_by(density_band) %>%
  summarise(
    persons = n(),
    households = n_distinct(HOUSEID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```



```{r}
# ==================================================
# 最终核查 D：交互分析可行性
# ==================================================

analysis_data %>%
  count(
    density_band,
    car_group
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = car_group,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```


```{r}
# ==================================================
# 最终核查 E：样本筛选流程
# ==================================================

sample_flow <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "All respondents",
    "Adults aged 18+",
    "Adult travellers",
    "Complete trip distances",
    "Valid population density",
    "Valid core covariates"
  ),

  remaining_n = c(
    nrow(person),
    nrow(adult),
    nrow(traveller),
    nrow(complete_distance),
    nrow(known_density),
    nrow(analysis_data)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded_n = lag(
      remaining_n,
      default = first(remaining_n)
    ) - remaining_n,

    retained_percent = round(
      100 * remaining_n / first(remaining_n),
      2
    )
  )

print(sample_flow)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 保存结果
# ==================================================

# 如果 processed 目录不存在，创建它
dir.create(
  "data/processed",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  "tables",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# 保存R原生数据格式
saveRDS(
  analysis_data,
  "data/processed/analysis_data.rds"
)

# 另存CSV，便于人工查看
write_csv(
  analysis_data,
  "data/processed/analysis_data.csv"
)

# 保存样本筛选表
write_csv(
  sample_flow,
  "tables/sample_flow.csv"
)
```
